counter_scope: facade file API; filesystem counters are not exposed; staged warm page-cache and no physical-I/O counter
limitation: facade-file uses the unified public Workbook API; filesystem counters are not exposed; the staged fixture is immutable and warm-cache, so physical I/O is not measured
timing_scope: facade-file family: public facade open/detection and query are inside elapsed_ns; compare elapsed_ns only within facade-file, never against source-backed or eager-file
process_scope: samples share one benchmark process; invoke once per retained sample for fresh-child evidence
input_scope: the original input is copied once outside timing into a private read-only staged file; all path-backed samples reopen that snapshot; full-file staging and post-run SHA-256 verification are outside elapsed_ns, warm the page cache, and do not measure cold or physical I/O

semantic_oracle.scope: implementation-local compatibility projections only; no independent source-parser oracle and no source/eager equivalence assertion
